note: Klarg is a bugbear (monster bugbear), Yeemik and the other goblins are goblins, Ripper is a wolf.

monsters.name: Redbrand Ruffian
monsters.attacks: Multiattack: two melee attacks. Shortsword +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., 5 (1d6+2) piercing. Skills Intimidation +2. CR 1/2.

monsters.name: Sildar Hallwinter
monsters.attacks: Multiattack: two melee attacks. Longsword +3 to hit, 5 (1d8+1) slashing. Heavy Crossbow +2 to hit, range 100/400 ft., 5 (1d10) piercing. Reaction Parry: +1d6 to AC against one melee hit while wielding a melee weapon. CR 1.

monsters.name: Evil Mage
monsters.attacks: Quarterstaff +1 to hit, 3 (1d8-1) bludgeoning. 4th-level spellcaster (Int, save DC 13, +5 to hit): cantrips light, mage hand, shocking grasp; 1st (4 slots) charm person, magic missile; 2nd (3 slots) hold person, misty step. CR 1. Used for Iarno Albrek (Glasstaff).

monsters.name: Mormesk the Wraith
monsters.attacks: Life Drain +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., 16 (3d8+3) necrotic and DC 13 Con save or hit point maximum drops by the damage until a long rest. Resists acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder, and nonmagical non-silvered weapons; immune necrotic, poison. Incorporeal Movement. Sunlight Sensitivity. CR 3.

monsters.name: Nezznar the Black Spider
monsters.attacks: Spider Staff +1 to hit, 2 (1d6-1) bludgeoning plus 3 (1d6) poison. Innate: dancing lights at will; darkness and faerie fire (DC 12) 1/day each. 4th-level wizard (Int, DC 13, +5): mage hand, ray of frost, shocking grasp; mage armor, magic missile, shield; invisibility, suggestion. Darkvision 120 ft., Fey Ancestry, Sunlight Sensitivity. CR 2.

monsters.name: Flameskull
monsters.attacks: See the module statistics in Appendix B / Monster Descriptions (fire bolt, fireball, rejuvenation).

monsters.name: Nothic
monsters.attacks: Multiattack: two claw attacks. Rotting Gaze (weird insight). See the module statistics for details.

monsters.name: Spectator
monsters.attacks: Bite +1 to hit, 2 (1d4-1) piercing. Eye Rays (two per turn, DC 13). Spell Reflection reaction. Darkvision 120 ft. CR 3.
